mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days as elevated interest rates compress equity valuations through higher discount rates and reduced corporate borrowing capacity.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or average 20-day return positive when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% in more than 60% of observations.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate below 3.5% signals labor market overheating and imminent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as equity valuations adjust to higher interest rates.
failure_condition: Average 20-day return positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% or Rank IC > 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and elevated CPI (CPIAUCSL > 310) signals stagflation risk, triggering central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day return positive in more than 60% of instances when both conditions hold or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During labor market tightness regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), S&P 500 returns are negative due to inflationary pressures forcing aggressive monetary policy and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: Average 20-day return positive in more than 60% of instances during UNRATE < 4.0% or Rank IC > 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days through improved business conditions.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or average 20-day return negative when INDPRO > 75th percentile.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1300 thousand units signal strong consumer demand and economic expansion, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day return negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1300 or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), S&P 500 returns are negative over 60 days due to prolonged higher interest rates suppressing corporate investment and earnings growth.
failure_condition: Average 60-day return positive in more than 60% of instances during FEDFUNDS > 5.0% or Rank IC > 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Combined strong housing starts (HOUST > 1250) and high consumer spending (RSAFS > 700000) signals robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days through immediate economic momentum.
failure_condition: Average 5-day return negative in more than 60% of instances when both conditions hold or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03.
